import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(2000)

k = 3
n = 6
node_size = n - 1
num_nodes = k ** node_size
mod = k ** (node_size - 1) if node_size > 0 else 1
total_edges = k ** n

remaining = [list(range(k)) for _ in range(num_nodes)]  # pop() will take from end, 2,1,0

cycle = []

def dfs(u):
    while remaining[u]:
        sym = remaining[u].pop()
        v = ((u % mod) * k + sym)
        dfs(v)
        cycle.append(sym)

start = 0
dfs(start)
cycle = cycle[::-1]

print(len(cycle) == total_edges)
print(cycle[:20])  # first few to check
print(cycle[-20:]) # last few
